tara: quick triage: onboarding 'tanager-embed-v1' (fp16 -> int6 per-channel) + observed odd drop in recall@1 on short queries. opening thread for run details.

matt: what holdout and eval config?

tara: holdout=short_queries_v2.json (5k queries), k=10. command: `python eval/holdout.py --model tanager-embed-v1 --quant int6-perchannel --holdout sets/short_queries_v2.json --batch 128`. summary: en r@1 0.582 (fp16 baseline 0.612), silhouette down 0.03.

olga: int6 is new; did you use asymmetric calibration or symmetric?

tara: symmetric with mean-zero clamp estimated via 5k calibration samples. no post-quant normalize.

matt: can you paste a couple of before/after NN lists? helps see semantic shifts.

tara: pasted two samples: Q1 "parse csv header python" baseline top3 [pandas.read_csv header, csv module example, stackoverflow snippet] quant top3 [csv module example, pandas.read_csv header, sys.stdin csv] -> small reorder. Q2 "symptoms of anemia" baseline [overview, labs, treatment] quant [labs, overview, causes] -> swap affecting overview rank.

bench-bot: eval-run 1745556666 started: artifact s3://evals/tanager/1745556666/report.html

olga: try two quick fixes: (A) per-channel asymmetric min/max calibration, (B) add L2 normalize after quant. also compute top-1 churn on 1k probe.

tara: running A and B now. will post results.

(20m)

tara: results: A (asymm) en r@1=0.598 silhouette +0.01; B (post-L2) en r@1=0.605 silhouette +0.02. churn: B top-1 churn 2.1% vs baseline; A churn 3.4%.

matt: post-L2 looks best tradeoff. any perf hit?

tara: int6 perf ~1.8x vs fp16; L2 cost negligible.

olga: plan: add runtime toggle for post-quant L2, add churn gate <3% for canary. Also add a tiny probe in CI to catch this earlier.

tara: filing PR #1599, will schedule 5% canary. bench-bot: eval-run 1745556666 completed: artifacts at s3://evals/tanager/1745556666/report.html

matt: thanks, good triage.
